The series includes a four-part story by [[Jason Aaron]], as well other stories by [[Peach Momoko]], [[Torunn Grønbekk]], and others. The series is illustrated by [[Leonard Kirk]], Peach Momoko, and more. The [[Darth Vader – Black, White & Red 1|first issue]] was published on [[April 26]], [[2023]].
